description: Documentation only, not executable Conan input or generated state. Referenced files are illustrative and require owner-reviewed implementation.

conan.version_policy: Use exact versions for all direct requirements in the Conan recipe; resolve transitive dependencies and record recipe/package revisions with Conan-native mechanisms.
conan.llvm_recipe_policy: Prefer a suitable existing recipe for LLVM 23.1.2; otherwise maintain one narrow project-owned Conan recipe.

ownership: Conan 2 owns dependency resolution, acquisition, source builds, package storage, package identity, and dependency locking; the Python wrapper only orchestrates Conan and the native build tools.
build_policy: A long first LLVM source build is acceptable. Reuse compatible Conan cache state; quiet builds continue while liveness checks show progress.
platform_policy: Windows x86_64 and Linux x86_64 are Tier 1; macOS is deferred Tier 2. These profiles illustrate native builds.
